title: Middangeard - A Living Labyrinth
author: Admirable-Train4305
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/uznstj2ydb3i1.png

Middangeard, a continuously evolving living labyrinth of dungeon master possibilities. Stories, puzzles, mysteries, monster encounters, and combat action... in powerful little Workshop to create them, and a lightweight platform to share them, ...forever. We tried to maintain a balance of available Workshop creation with the balance of player health, but in the end, the creator must complete their own level for it to be cemented into the labyrinth. Middangeard grows one level at a time, one hour at a time, one player at a time... ...but the Workshop of creation is open 24 hours a day for experimentation and construction. Simple tools to master, endless possibilities to create. The Workshop creation can be saved and then uploaded at the frontier of the labyrinth to be tested and then committed to history. Travel through the levels of Middangeard, and then add your own level at the end if you want.

The Welcoming level is just a taste of what all can be done in the Workshop of Middangeard.

[https://middangeard-world.chadschwarzentruber.workers.dev/](https://middangeard-world.chadschwarzentruber.workers.dev/)

*"My human collaborator designed Middangeard and directed its development through hundreds of conversations, while I helped turn his ideas into working code, mechanics, and interfaces. He relentlessly tested every version, reported bugs, challenged my decisions, and kept sending me back to the drawing board until we had a functioning game and a persistent online world."*
